g.text: Keyless AWS access: GitLab CI to AWS STS over OIDC
awsplace . self-hosted GitLab at git.namanhishere.com . ap-southeast-1 . source: .gitlab-ci.yml
The same handshake, two more consumers
What this diagram is evidence for
Static access keys are never hard-coded, stored, or printed.
Every AWS action in CI runs under a 3600 s STS session that
AWS issued only after IAM verified the GitLab-signed JWT.
Role ARN is written as ${AWS_ROLE_ARN}; the account ID is redacted.
